Joanna Elson of the Independent Age charity is concerned about poverty among pensioners and says ministers need to think hard before making changes You report ( 11 November ) Torsten Bell’s suggestion that the Conservatives would need to raise the state pension age above 70 to meet the cost of keeping the triple lock. It is well known that raising the state pension age increases poverty rates among those who have to wait longer for it, with those on the lowest incomes hit the hardest.
